output.description: Runs the backup script for a backup set to create a fresh backup, then deletes old backups beyond the retention count. Restricts permissions so kept backups are owner-only read/write (mode 600) and the backup set directory is owner-only (mode 700). Returns the script output plus deletion and permission messages.
output.declaring_phrase: Restricts permissions so kept backups are owner-only read/write (mode 600) and the backup set directory is owner-only (mode 700)
